# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Status:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, Massachusetts  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has an exceptionally delicate and refined face framed in a halo of chestnut curls, with big, dark blue eyes and a crimson, sweet-lipped mouth. Although small for his age, he has a meditative, grave expression that makes him appear older than he is. When he smiles, his entire face lights up with an inner radiance.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Paul is a dreamy, imaginative, and deeply sensitive boy with a poetic nature. He possesses a vivid imagination, populating his world with fantastical 'rock people' and romantic stories. Though quiet and thoughtful, he is also manly, good-tempered, and well-liked by his peers. He cherishes his memories of his mother and is fiercely loyal and affectionate toward those he trusts.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c15 P10](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0010)_

## Traits

- Highly imaginative  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- Poetic and sensitive  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033)</sub>

## Abilities

- Talented at writing imaginative stories and compositions  <sub>[v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- Capable athlete in school games  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Goals

- To grow up and reunite permanently with his father  <sub>[v2 c15 P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008)</sub>
- To become a poet  <sub>[v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033)</sub>

## History

Paul Irving moved from Boston to Avonlea to live with his grandmother, Mrs. Irving, on the shore road. Upon entering the Avonlea school under Anne Shirley's tutelage, he immediately formed a deep, kindred-spirit bond with her due to their shared imaginative nature. Throughout his school year, he proved to be an exceptional student, excelling in compositions and gaining the affection of his teacher and classmates alike. When his young sister-figure Minnie May was ill or when he suffered from homesickness, he found solace in his imaginative 'rock people' on the shore and his bond with Anne. During his father's unexpected visit, Paul introduced his father to Anne and later arranged for him to visit Miss Lavendar Lewis, unaware of their romantic past. This meeting ultimately led to his father's reconciliation and marriage to Miss Lavendar, bringing Paul immense joy as he prepared to move to Boston with them.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c15 P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 c23 P1](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0001), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026), [v2 c30 P10](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Born in the United States to Stephen Irving and his deceased wife  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- Sent to live with his grandmother in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- Raised in his earliest years by his mother, who died when he was around seven or eight  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c15 P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009)</sub>

## Quotes

> I like you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> Isn't it splendid to be that kind, teacher?  <sub>[v2 c15 P19](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0019)</sub>

> I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes... the look my little mother always had.  <sub>[v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

> Father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time.  <sub>[v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)</sub>
